data.body:
1. Retain birth1902-06-22, baptism1902-07-06, mother/unknown father, mother's dated occupation/residence and83 14/1, the two witness roles, and directed certificate. June22 comes from own day/month ditto; source is the contemporary birth register. Full place is administrative Flen recording, not certified physical delivery location.
2. **Correct earlier direct-reading claims** `1`, `ett levande oäkta gossebarn`, and `ogift` attributed to C0084. Row34 count trace is insufficient for1; mother's four status cells blank; no explicit oäkta wording. Do not infer these as literal cells from given name, piga or father okänd. Sex/civil-status knowledge from different stronger records may be retained with exact support, but cannot be called C0084's explicit observation.
3. Do not infer stillbirth or female sex from missing count. Baptism records the child living at baptism; this is not the same as a clearly marked count/sex cell. Source has no explicit legitimacy category. Retain unknown father; do not transform this correction into a new father or rejection of existing mother identity.
4. P0117/P0118 identities remain accepted through full name/family chain already reviewed; the Hyltinge September27 conflict remains with own birthJune22 prioritised. Repeated Flen chain is dependent, not multiple independent date votes. P0133/P0135 witness links remain candidates: unnamed wife and ErikKarlsson/Brosätter cannot certify grandparents.
5. Bounded adoption subjects: P0117 mother, P0118 child, P0133/P0135 candidate witness identities with candidate caveat. No new person or parental link; existing minister mention remains reserved.
6. Existing historical transcription TR-947c0c8fae6d908aa48b973b@1 explicitly says it preserves older text. Retain its literal history if a current full-field transcription and reading assessment explicitly supersede its1 and uncertain day; do NOT overwrite history or pass the old text off as current new reading.
